decision_reason: RETAIN nonasserting alignment/prefetch smoke test: original prefetches potentially unaligned addresses and exits unconditionally. On PDP6 lacking a prefetch instruction, calls can compile away; GCC PDP6 O0 PASS but there is no alignment/fault/side-effect assertion and KCC noopt LINK_FAIL on unavailable builtin. Need a true compile/codegen fault policy before scheduling; no fake prefetch.

RETAIN nonasserting invalid-address prefetch smoke test: original prefetches invented addresses and exits without validating effects, uses bits_per_ptr=8*sizeof(void*) despite native PDP10 CHAR_BIT=9 and uses 1UL shifts with native 36-bit long. GCC PDP6 O0 PASS is not proof of a no-fault target prefetch instruction. KCC noopt LINK_FAIL for unsupported builtin. Preserve for native width and meaningful codegen oracle.

ACTIVATE GCC compile-time type compatibility: array bound __builtin_types_compatible_p(int,typeof(i)), plus six compatible and six incompatible type expression assertions covering qualifiers, enums, arrays, typedefs, pointers and long-double/double. GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os PASS. Emitted main folds comparisons to exit, which is a narrow compile-time constant-fold oracle, not runtime ABI evidence. KCC noopt COMPILE_FAIL GNU typeof/builtin.

RETAIN PDP10-inapplicable IEEE-754 32-bit-word cube-root implementation: lowercase-only __pdp10__ exclusion fails to match real uppercase __PDP10__; GCC PDP6 O0 enters Sun 32-bit-double word-splitting algorithm and RUN_FAIL, KCC noopt rejects GNU mode(SI). Selecting the intended PDP10 exclusion would reduce source to main(){exit(0);} with NO cube-root assertion, so do not promote a vacuous pass or fake a D-format implementation.

ACTIVATE KCC and GCC after a single target-macro guard fix: 8x8 pairs and ten signed/unsigned long-long comparison functions check 640 fixed T/F expected results for 71-bit PDP10 long long. Independently recomputed all 640 entries; expected table matches exactly 71-bit signed/unsigned comparisons. Historical lowercase __pdp10__ guard erroneously selected 64-bit input arguments; recognize __PDP10__ or lowercase without changing a single table constant. Original KCC noopt and GCC O0 RUN_FAIL; corrected KCC noopt PASS but KCC optimized RUN_FAIL, so CPU-wide KCC matrix conservatively fail. Corrected GCC O0/O1/O2/Os PASS. Preserve KCC exact mode split.

RETAIN hosted pointer/data-model-dependent computed-goto emulator: original allocates via actual malloc(2*4096), does 32-bit guest page encoding and <<2 byte offsets with a 36-bit PDP10 int and 9-bit chars, uses labels-as-values and checks simulator_kernel result==88. GCC PDP6 O0 LINK_FAIL for missing real malloc; KCC noopt COMPILE_FAIL for GNU extension. No fake allocator and no redefinition of address/byte semantics.

ACTIVATE GCC GNU nested-function nonlocal goto: recursive y helper with address of llab and nonlocal goto xlab, x(DEPTH) must equal original depth or main aborts. GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os PASS. O0 and O2 generated code retains recursive y%0, indirect JRST, and main comparison. KCC noopt rejects __label__/nested function extension; no KCC profile scheduled.

ACTIVATE GCC double complex arithmetic: original cexp(1.0i) computes real part -1.0 and imaginary 0.0 with __real__/__imag__ operations, with two genuine abort checks. GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os PASS; O0 and O2 assembly calls cexp and contains real/imag comparisons. KCC noopt COMPILE_FAIL GNU complex syntax.

ACTIVATE GCC with O0 failure: by-value double-complex f(x,y) computes x+=y; main requires unchanged a=1+i, b=-2+2i, result c=-1+3i. GCC PDP6 O0 RUN_FAIL despite emitted comparisons; O1/O2/Os PASS with real f call and six component comparisons. Register fail/semantic/semantic/semantic; KCC noopt COMPILE_FAIL GNU complex syntax.

ACTIVATE narrowly scoped GCC constant-fold comparison of complex signed zero: (__complex__ double)0.0 == (__complex__ double)(-0.0) and scalar 0.0 == -0.0 must both hold or abort. GCC PDP6 O0/O1/O2/Os PASS, emitted main is an unconditional exit due valid constant evaluation; no claim of runtime floating-unit or signed-zero storage coverage. KCC noopt COMPILE_FAIL GNU complex syntax.
